$comment: Lesson video production. See video/README.md. Nothing here is read by the site build. Secrets never go in this file: HEYGEN_API_KEY, MUX_TOKEN_ID and MUX_TOKEN_SECRET come from the environment (.env).

voice.$comment: No default on purpose: there is no system/default TTS. Pick one: heygen | local-clone | file. HeyGen is a cloud service and runs only when selected here or with --provider=heygen.

heygen.$comment: mode 'clone' = your professional voice clone (POST /v3/models/audio/tts). mode 'voice' = any HeyGen voice (POST /v3/voices/speech).

localClone.$comment: Run once per beat. Placeholders: {textFile} (UTF-8 text to speak), {out} (WAV to write), {beat} (beat id). Example: python3 ~/voice-clone/speak.py --text-file {textFile} --out {out}

file.$comment: Bring your own narration: a WAV/MP3 you recorded. Pass --file=… or set path.

avatar.$comment: none | heygen. HeyGen renders a talking-head video of your avatar.

heygen.$commentVoice: true = lip-sync to the voice stage's audio (your clone). false = let HeyGen speak the script with voiceId below.

edit.$commentRecordings: Screen recordings for the lesson, if any: put them in <workDir>/<route>/recordings/ named beat-003.mov etc. to pin them to a beat.
